title: Side leg lift at the wall

steps.text: Stand side-on to a wall with one hand resting on it.
steps.cue: Side-on to the wall, one hand on it.

steps.text: Keep your toes facing forward and lift your outside leg out to the side.
steps.cue: Toes forward. Lift the leg to the side.

steps.text: Stay upright. Lift only as far as you can without leaning.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then turn round and change legs.

mistakes: Tipping the body toward the wall.
Turning the toes out to lift higher.
regression: Slide your foot out along the floor instead of lifting it.
stopIf: Stop if you feel pain in your hip or lower back.

anatomy.why: The side of the hip lifts the leg out, and on the standing side it keeps the pelvis level.
